notes.title: Behind the Scenes: 6 Months of Work, Big Update Ahead
notes.notes:
Dear players,

We apologize for the long silence. It's time to share what’s been happening with World of Shooting over the past six months as we move toward full release.

[i]Please note that the following changes are not yet available, but we’ll start rolling out updates to the beta version soon — followed by a release to the main branch.[/i]

🔧 What’s new and improved:

[list]
[*]     We’ve significantly reworked the content and textures for the IPSC levels, including new decorations and visual improvements.
[*]     The Killhouse Campaign is now in its final development stage, with new decorations and improved game balance.
[*]     We’ve redesigned the core gameplay balance — we hope you’ll enjoy the changes!
[*]     Nearly all pistol reload animations have been updated and refined.
[*]     We've added several new weapons to the game. (Yes, we know you love having lots of guns!)
[*]     The game interface now supports 5 additional languages — though we'll definitely need your help polishing the translations.
[/list]

🎉 Also:
The Summer Sale is live — don’t miss the chance to grab select DLCs at a discount!

notes.title: Small update you should know about!
notes.notes:
We just released small update!
1. Upon a lot of user requests we added possibility to buy exp points to the matches. (Anyway you may play without donations it is interesting)
2. Quiz questions - we changed upon user reviews. 1 question will be easy in 90%. Then medium and the difficult.
3. Reloading animation slider - no penalties it will not slow down you. Also if you missed acceleration area you may acelerate another one, so it is not so hardcore now. (we still have small bugs with bolt action rifles and animation slider, we wil fix it ASAP)

Thank you for your support!!!

P.S. We collect crash logs to fix  some crashes users experienced during stages loading.
